create_barcode.description: Turn a product number, SKU or shipping code into a barcode image (EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128, ITF-14, EAN-8 or Code 39), ready for a label, a price tag or a document. Retail numbers can be given without their last digit, and it is worked out; a wrong last digit is caught before anything is drawn. The image is saved so later steps can attach or upload it.
create_barcode.name: create_barcode

parameters.description: The number or text to put in the barcode. For EAN-13, UPC-A, ITF-14 and EAN-8 use digits only; you can leave off the last digit (the check digit). Code 128 takes letters, digits and symbols, up to 80 characters.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: EAN-13 is the product barcode used in most of the world; UPC-A is the US and Canada one. Code 128 suits SKUs, serial and order numbers with letters in them. ITF-14 is printed on shipping cartons. EAN-8 is for small packs, and Code 39 for older warehouse scanners.
parameters.name: barcode_type

parameters.description: PNG suits email, documents and the web. Choose SVG for labels and print: it stays sharp at any size.
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.description: How thick the bars are, from 1 (thinnest) to 8. A wider setting makes a bigger image. A long Code 128 or Code 39 may need a thinner setting to save as PNG.
parameters.name: bar_width

parameters.description: How tall the bars are, in millimetres, from 5 to 50.
parameters.name: height_mm

parameters.description: Print the human-readable value under the bars.
parameters.name: show_text

parameters.description: Optional. The name to save the image under, e.g. product-label.png. Without it, the name is made from what the code holds.
parameters.name: filename

barcode_type.description: The kind of barcode drawn, e.g. EAN-13.

check_digit_added.description: True when the last digit was missing and was worked out for you.

content_type.description: File type of the image: image/png or image/svg+xml.

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved image, for use by a later step.

documents.description: The image, in the shape steps that send or upload files expect.

content_type.description: File type of the image: image/png or image/svg+xml.

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved image, for use by a later step.

filename.description: Name the image was saved under.

size_bytes.description: Size of the image in bytes.

url.description: Download link for the saved image.

encoded_value.description: Exactly what the barcode holds, including a check digit worked out for you.

filename.description: Name the image was saved under.

image_url.description: A public GeraCode link that always shows this same image. Use it in an email, a web page or a spreadsheet IMAGE() formula. Anyone with the link can see what the code holds.

size_bytes.description: Size of the image in bytes.

url.description: Download link for the saved image.

create_qr_code.description: Turn a link or any other text (up to 1,200 characters, accents and emoji included) into a QR code image, ready to email, print or drop into a document. The image is saved so later steps can attach or upload it.
create_qr_code.name: create_qr_code

parameters.description: What the code should hold. A web address opens when scanned; anything else is shown as text.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: PNG suits email, documents and the web. Choose SVG for labels and print: it stays sharp at any size.
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.description: How many pixels across the code is, from 100 to 1000. QR codes are square.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: How much of the code can be scratched or covered and still scan. Higher levels make the pattern denser; Standard suits most uses.
parameters.name: error_correction

parameters.description: Blank space around the code, counted in code squares, from 0 to 10. Keep at least 2 so phones read it easily.
parameters.name: margin

parameters.description: Optional. The name to save the image under, e.g. menu-qr.png. Without it, the name is made from what the code holds.
parameters.name: filename

content_type.description: File type of the image: image/png or image/svg+xml.

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved image, for use by a later step.

documents.description: The image, in the shape steps that send or upload files expect.

content_type.description: File type of the image: image/png or image/svg+xml.

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved image, for use by a later step.

filename.description: Name the image was saved under.

size_bytes.description: Size of the image in bytes.

url.description: Download link for the saved image.

encoded_text.description: The exact text stored in the code.

filename.description: Name the image was saved under.

image_url.description: A public GeraCode link that always shows this same image. Use it in an email, a web page or a spreadsheet IMAGE() formula. Anyone with the link can see what the code holds.

size_bytes.description: Size of the image in bytes.

url.description: Download link for the saved image.

description: Make barcodes and QR codes for products, labels and inventory with GeraCode, a free image service. Turn a product number into an EAN-13, UPC-A, ITF-14 or EAN-8 barcode (the check digit is worked out or checked for you), a SKU into a Code 128, or a link into a QR code, as a PNG or a print-ready SVG.
